https://bridges.brookfield.example/alder.body:
Alder Bridge

The Alder Bridge is 210 metres long. It was built in 1932 by Hartmann & Sons and carries the main road over the river Brook.

https://bridges.brookfield.example/oakli.body:
Oakline Viaduct

The Oakline Viaduct is 540 metres long. It was built by Brandt Engineering and opened on 5 June 1998.

https://hartmann-sons.example/about.body:
Hartmann & Sons

Hartmann & Sons is a family company founded in 1887. Its head office is in Weissbach. The company employs 140 people.

https://brandt-engineering.example/about.body:
Brandt Engineering

Brandt Engineering was founded in 1971. Its head office is in Kellerau. The company specialises in steel structures.

https://weissbach.example/town.body:
Weissbach

Weissbach is a town with 12,400 inhabitants. The mayor of Weissbach is Anna Keller.

https://kellerau.example/town.body:
Kellerau

Kellerau is a town with 31,900 inhabitants. The mayor of Kellerau is Tom Ruiz.

https://books.example/lena-moser.body:
Dr. Lena Moser

Dr. Lena Moser, born in 1961 in Weissbach, is a geographer. She is the author of the book The River Atlas.

https://books.example/the-river-atlas.body:
The River Atlas

The River Atlas was published in 2004 and describes the rivers of the region.

https://alder-museum.example/about.body:
Alder Museum

The Alder Museum was founded in 1910. Its director is Jonas Pell. The museum shows tools and machines.

https://glass-museum.example/about.body:
Glass Museum

The Glass Museum was founded in 1985. Its director is Mira Cole. The museum shows glass art.

https://brookfield.example/fair-2024.body:
Brookfield Fair 2024

The Brookfield Fair has been held every autumn since 1952. The 2024 fair opens on 14 September 2024.

https://brookfield.example/library.body:
Brookfield library

The Brookfield library was founded in 1895. It has 14,000 members.

https://history.brookfield.example/alder.body:
The old Alder ferry

Before the bridge, a ferry crossed the river Brook at the Alder meadow. The ferry stopped running in 1932.

https://brookfield.example/companies-reg.body:
Register of companies in Brookfield

The register lists companies of the region: shipyards, bakeries and a printing house. It does not say what any of them built or where they were founded.
